# Red Grid MGRS

> Red Grid MGRS is a zero-network, offline-first tactical navigation app for iOS and Android. It puts DAGR-class military-grade MGRS (Military Grid Reference System) navigation in your pocket: 10-digit grid precision, offline tactical maps, land-navigation tools, NATO report templates, and optional Meshtastic mesh awareness, with no accounts, no analytics, and no tracking. Location is computed on-device, held in memory only, and never transmitted.

## Key facts
- Platforms: iOS 12+ and Android (API 24+).
- Positioning: a "$2,500 DAGR-class MGRS navigator" for field operators, search-and-rescue, and land-navigation training. Built in collaboration with active-duty and retired U.S. Army soldiers.
- Privacy: zero network calls for core features, no accounts, no analytics, no tracking, location in-memory only.
- MGRS engine: DMA Technical Manual 8358.1 compliant: it truncates (not rounds) intermediate UTM values, matching military receivers (DAGR, PLGR) and NGA GeoTrans, so it stays in the correct grid square at boundaries.
- Pricing: free core app; Pro adds a 7-day free trial, then $3.99/month, $29.99/year, or $199.99 lifetime.
- 16 in-app languages.

## Features
- Free: 6-digit MGRS (100 m precision), offline map, three land-nav tools (back azimuth, pace count, declination), three NATO report templates (SALUTE, 9-line MEDEVAC, SPOT), one theme, one waypoint.
- Pro: 10-digit MGRS (1 m precision); all ten tools (adds dead reckoning, resection, time-distance-speed, sun/moon, MGRS precision, elevation/slope, photo geostamp); offline tactical map packages; shareable route cards; unlimited waypoint lists with GPX/KML import & export; all six NATO reports (adds ICS 201, CASEVAC, ANGUS/CFF); all themes (NVG green, day white, blue-force); Meshtastic mesh-node awareness over Bluetooth; extra coordinate formats (UTM, lat/lon, DMS, FixPhrase); HUD mode.

## Common questions
- What is MGRS? The Military Grid Reference System: the NATO standard for reporting ground position. It is more precise and less error-prone for land navigation than latitude/longitude.
- Does it work offline? Yes. All core navigation works with no signal; download map tiles in advance.
- Is my location tracked? No. Location is computed on-device, held in memory, and never sent anywhere.
- How is it different from a phone's built-in maps? It is purpose-built for MGRS land navigation, works fully offline, and makes zero network calls.
